about_the_game:
Introducing a fresh, exciting mode to CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2! As the name implies, we're opening a maid cafe, and we're waiting for you, Master! Come check out the cute maid cafe, the live streams that use motion capture, and the awesome costumes!

We're going to have the cutest time of our lives, and trust us--you don't want to miss out!

-What is the Empire Maid Cafe?-

The Empire Maid Cafe is an open cafe based on the concept of a "casual Empire Club."
Unlike normal Empire Clubs, entry is open to everyone.

-New Character-

Strong-Willed

cv. Minamijuji Issei

The main character of Empire Maid Cafe mode. She's assertive, determined, and a hard worker when it comes to getting what she wants. She also has the focus and clarity of mind needed to direct Gyaru's chaotic energy to more productive ends. She likes being the dominant partner with guys, and once she's got her sights on you, she won't let you get away.
